note: Norman County (MN) publishes its zoning only as a PDF ordinance with a separate Zoning District Map. Its public ArcGIS server (gismap.co.norman.mn.us, folder Norman: LandRecords, PublicDataLayers, Norman_Internal_LINK, ConnectExplorer) has parcels, municipalities and environmental layers but no zoning districts. The City of Ada, the largest city, publishes its zoning map only as a static PDF (Zoning_Map.pdf). No queryable zoning polygon service was found for Norman County or Ada, Halstad or Twin Valley. The only zoning-attributed parcel data is Regrid's commercial standardized zoning (17% populated), not an official service.
